name: Gödöllő (Hungary)
description: A vertical blue banner with a white triangle descending from the top edge to a point near the bottom, charged in the triangle with the town arms of Gödöllő: a blue shield with a helm, a crest of ears of grain and red and blue mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
